 Advocate for : MR. R GOSWAMI  Advocate for : appearing for RANJITA DAS AND 4 ORS.
 BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE KALYAN RAI SURANA  ORDER Date : 17.10.2023 Heard Mr. R. Goswami, learned counsel for the applicant.

By filing this application under Section XLI, Rule V CPC, the applicant has prayed for stay of the judgment and award dated 21.07.2023, passed by the learned Member, MACT No.3, Kamrup (Metropolitan), Guwahati in MAC Case No.2052/2017.
The applicant shall take steps within 2 (two) days for service of notice on the opposite parties by usual process as well as by registered post with A/D.

The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the deceased was a pillion rider in a motor cycle, which was insured under the Act Policy and it is submitted that there are judicial pronouncement wherein it has been laid down that if a pillion rider dies in a road accident involving vehicle having Act Policy, the pillion rider would not be entitled to compensation.
